name: EM FX Carry-to-Vol Monthly Ranking (BRL, MXN, ZAR)
description: Monthly carry-to-vol ranking of BRL, MXN, ZAR vs USD. Carry = 1-month rate differential (EM overnight/interbank rate minus US Fed Funds) / 12 in decimal. Vol = 30-day realized vol / sqrt(12). Score = carry / max(vol, 0.001) to prevent division by zero. Ranks 3 currencies each month-end (rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol). Next-month EM FX return paired to the rank active at the start of that month (rank_ffilled >> 1 at each month-end). Shows avg return, hit rate, and count by rank via a bar chart and stats table.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX CARRY-TO-VOL MONTHLY RANKING: BRL, MXN, ZAR vs USD
# =============================================================================
# Carry = (EM 1M rate - US Fed Funds rate) / 12  → monthly rate differential
# Vol   = 30-day realized vol (annualized) / sqrt(12) → monthly vol
# Score = Carry / Vol  (carry-to-vol ratio)
# Rank  = cs_rank each month-end (rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol)
# Signal: Does rank 1 outperform rank 3 next month?
#
# FX convention: USDBRL = USD per BRL (higher = weaker BRL)
# EM FX return (USD investor) = -return(USDFX pair)
# =============================================================================

# --- Daily FX price data (primary market_data_source) ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- FRED: Short-term interest rates (annualized %, monthly) ---
# Brazil: Immediate interbank rate (SELIC proxy)
brl_ei_obs, brl_rate_raw, brl_ei_rev = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N', use_alfred=False)()
# Mexico: Immediate interbank rate (Banxico proxy)
mxn_ei_obs, mxn_rate_raw, mxn_ei_rev = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01MXM156N', use_alfred=False)()
# South Africa: 3-month interbank rate (SARB proxy)
zar_ei_obs, zar_rate_raw, zar_ei_rev = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N', use_alfred=False)()
# US: Fed Funds Effective Rate
usd_ei_obs, usd_rate_raw, usd_ei_rev = economic_indicators(series_id='FEDFUNDS', use_alfred=False)()

# Forward-fill FRED monthly rates to daily bars (rates persist until next release)
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw)
usd_rate = ffill(usd_rate_raw)

# --- Identify which asset we're on (for per-asset rate selection) ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDZAR')()

# Select the correct EM rate for each FX pair
em_rate = conditional_select(is_brl, brl_rate, is_mxn, mxn_rate, is_zar, zar_rate, brl_rate)

# --- Monthly carry differential (annualized % → monthly fraction) ---
# Rates are in % per annum → divide by 100 to get decimal, then /12 for monthly
carry_monthly = (em_rate - usd_rate) / 100.0 / 12.0

# --- 30-day realized vol of daily FX returns (annualized) ---
# FX return from USD investor perspective: -return(USDFX) = EM currency appreciation
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
em_fx_ret = -daily_ret   # positive = EM currency appreciated vs USD

# Annualized vol from 30-day window, then convert to monthly
vol_ann = volatility(period=30)(close)          # annualized vol (decimal fraction)
vol_monthly = vol_ann / sqrt(12.0)              # monthly vol

# --- Carry-to-Vol score (floor vol at 0.001 to prevent division by zero) ---
vol_floor = vol_monthly if vol_monthly > 0.001 else 0.001
carry_to_vol = carry_monthly / vol_floor

# =============================================================================
# MONTHLY RANKING LOGIC
# =============================================================================
# At each month-end bar, rank the 3 currencies by carry-to-vol (descending)
# Rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol (best carry per unit of risk)

# Month-end boundary signal
month_end = is_period_boundary(period='month', boundary='end')(index())

# Snapshot carry-to-vol at month-end, null on all other bars
ctv_snapshot = where(month_end, carry_to_vol)

# Cross-sectional rank at month-end (descending: rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol)
# cs_rank ascending=False → rank 1 = highest value
ctv_rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(ctv_snapshot)

# Forward-fill rank through the month (so every daily bar knows its current rank)
rank_ffilled = ffill(ctv_rank)

# =============================================================================
# NEXT-MONTH FX RETURN
# =============================================================================
# Monthly FX return (EM currency appreciation from USD investor perspective)
# Use forward_returns on the monthly close-to-close return
# We compute this on daily data: next month-end close vs current month-end close

# Month-end close price (snapshot)
close_eom = where(month_end, close)
close_eom_filled = ffill(close_eom)

# Monthly return of the FX pair (USDFX): positive = USD strengthened (EM weakened)
# EM investor return = negative of this
monthly_fx_ret_usd = (close_eom / (close_eom_filled >> 1) - 1.0)   # return of USDFX pair
em_monthly_ret = -monthly_fx_ret_usd                          # EM currency return (USD investor)

# Only valid at month-end bars (where we have a complete month)
em_ret_eom = where(month_end, em_monthly_ret)

# =============================================================================
# ASSIGN NEXT-MONTH RETURN TO EACH RANK BUCKET
# =============================================================================
# At month-end T+1: em_ret_eom[T+1] = return from T to T+1 (this month's return)
# rank_ffilled >> 1 at T+1 = rank assigned at T (previous month-end, via ffill >> 1 daily bar)
# This correctly pairs each month's realized return with the rank active at the start of that month.
# No look-ahead: em_ret_eom is computed from current and prior month-end closes only.

prev_rank_at_eom = where(month_end, rank_ffilled >> 1)

is_rank1 = prev_rank_at_eom == 1.0
is_rank2 = prev_rank_at_eom == 2.0
is_rank3 = prev_rank_at_eom == 3.0

ret_rank1 = where(is_rank1, em_ret_eom)   # returns when ranked #1 (top carry-to-vol)
ret_rank2 = where(is_rank2, em_ret_eom)   # returns when ranked #2 (mid)
ret_rank3 = where(is_rank3, em_ret_eom)   # returns when ranked #3 (bottom carry-to-vol)

# Hit rate: 1 if positive return, 0 otherwise
hit_rank1 = where(is_rank1, 1.0 if em_ret_eom > 0 else 0.0)
hit_rank2 = where(is_rank2, 1.0 if em_ret_eom > 0 else 0.0)
hit_rank3 = where(is_rank3, 1.0 if em_ret_eom > 0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTING
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart: Avg Next-Month Return by Carry-to-Vol Rank ---
# Use xy_bars with series mode (3 bars: Rank 1, Rank 2, Rank 3)
# Each bar = mean of all next-month returns when currency held that rank
xy_bars(
    title='Avg Next-Month EM FX Return by Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    category='Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Next-Month Return (USD Investor)',
    x_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 1 (Top)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 2 (Mid)', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 3 (Bottom)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(ret_rank1, ret_rank2, ret_rank3))

# --- Stats Table: Avg Return, Hit Rate, Count by Rank ---
# Layout: 3 rows (Rank 1, Rank 2, Rank 3) x 3 cols (Avg Return, Hit Rate, Count)
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry-to-Vol Rank vs Next-Month FX Return',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Rank 1 (Top)', 'Rank 2 (Mid)', 'Rank 3 (Bottom)'],
        col_headers=['Avg Next-Month Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Observations'],
        cells=[
            # Rank 1 row
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Rank 2 row
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Rank 3 row
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    order=0
)(ret_rank1, hit_rank1, ret_rank1, ret_rank2, hit_rank2, ret_rank2, ret_rank3, hit_rank3, ret_rank3)
